title: Titanium Ultrasonic Rotary Horn
function: Monobloc ultrasonic rotary horn core for continuous seal
alloyReason: Triaxially forged Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (Triaxially Forged) (UNS R56400) is specified for this ultrasonic tooling component where isotropic properties are mandatory. The 3D forging eliminates texture directionality, delivering uniform 950 MPa tensile in all orientations under multi-axial stress. This rationale is driven by monobloc ultrasonic rotary horn core for continuous seal and specific design requirements.
process: CNC turn-mill multi-axis for ultrasonic tooling geometry
Shot peening Almen at 200W fiber laser
Black oxide/DLC coating at 200W fiber laser
CMM SPC dimensional check at 200W fiber laser
surfaceTreatment: DLC coating 2um, 15GPa hardness, 0.1mu friction coefficient applied to wear surfaces for extended durability — tailored for monobloc ultrasonic rotary application
commonFailures: Fatigue crack at thread-shank transition - prevented by larger fillet R0.5->1.5mm + cold rolling — critical for monobloc ultrasonic rotary performance

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Ultrasonic Rotary Horn suitable for Monobloc ultrasonic rotary horn core for continuous seal?
faq.a: Titanium Ultrasonic Rotary Horn uses Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address ultrasonic tooling operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Ultrasonic Rotary Horn?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Ultrasonic Rotary Horn is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for monobloc ultrasonic rotary requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Ultrasonic Rotary Horn require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. monobloc ultrasonic rotary components require DLC coating 2um, 15GPa hardness, 0.1mu friction coefficient applied to wear surfaces for extended durability — tailored for monobloc ultrasonic rotary application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Ultrasonic Rotary Horn shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Ultrasonic Rotary Horn includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet monobloc ultrasonic rotary specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for Rotary horn / Seal horn ultrasonic tooling components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
